🚂 Alphabet Train

 
 
🚂

All aboard!

The train needs your help. Find the right letter so it can keep going!

For grown-ups: ABC uses capital letters, abc uses small letters, and A→a shows a capital letter and asks her to find the small one that matches. A to Z rides through the whole alphabet in order, and Mix up picks 10 letters at random. Often one of the wrong choices is a look-alike letter (b/d, m/n, E/F), so she has to look closely.
